name: Deploy to Production Render

on:
  push:
    # Pattern matched against refs/tags
    tags:
      - "**" # Push events to every tag not containing /
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write

jobs:
  push-docker-image:
    name: Push Docker Image
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production

    steps:
      # 1) Check out your repo
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # 2) Log in to GitHub container registry
      - name: Log in to the Container registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      # 3) Extract docker metadata for tagging
      - name: Extract metadata (tags, labels) for Docker
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ghcr.io/purplefish-ai/agent

      # 4) Build and push Docker image
      - name: Build and push Docker image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: ./Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
  deploy-to-render:
    name: Deploy to Render
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [push-docker-image]
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        # the rest is deploy via github actions in monorepo and ai-agents
        service:
          [
            "agent-inbound",
            "agent",
            "voice-agent",
            "routing-agent",
            "datadog-agent",
          ]
        include:
          - service: agent-inbound
            service_id_env_key: RENDER_AGENT_INBOUND_ID
          - service: agent
            service_id_env_key: RENDER_AGENT_ID
          - service: voice-agent
            service_id_env_key: RENDER_VOICE_AGENT_ID
          - service: routing-agent
            service_id_env_key: RENDER_ROUTING_AGENT_ID
          - service: datadog-agent
            service_id_env_key: RENDER_DATADOG_AGENT_ID
    steps:
      - name: Install Render CLI
        run: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/render-oss/cli/refs/heads/main/bin/install.sh | sh

      - name: Trigger Render deployment
        env:
          # The CLI can authenticate via a Render API key without logging in.
          RENDER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.RENDER_API_KEY }}
          RENDER_PROJECT_ID: ${{ secrets[matrix.service_id_env_key] }}
          CI: true
        run: render deploys create $RENDER_PROJECT_ID --output json --confirm --wait

  # # 8) Run Hamming Workflow (only if inbound deploy succeeded)
  # run-hamming-workflow:
  #   name: Run Hamming Workflow
  #   needs: [deploy]  # Wait until the 'deploy' job finishes successfully
  #   uses: HammingHQ/hamming-ci-workflow/.github/workflows/hamming_run_agent.yml@main
  #   with:
  #     agent_id: ${{ vars.AGENT_ID }}
  #     dataset_id: ${{ vars.DATASET_ID }}
  #     to_number: ${{ vars.TO_NUMBER }}
  #   secrets:
  #     HAMMING_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.HAMMING_API_KEY }}

name: Deploy to Production Render

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write

jobs:
  check-release-commit:
    name: Check for Release Commit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      is-release: ${{ steps.check.outputs.is-release }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check if commit is a semantic release
        id: check
        run: |
          # Get the commit message
          COMMIT_MSG="${{ github.event.head_commit.message }}"
          echo "Commit message: $COMMIT_MSG"

          # Check if it matches semantic release commit format
          if [[ "$COMMIT_MSG" =~ ^chore\(release\):\ v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+ ]]; then
            echo "This is a semantic release commit"
            echo "is-release=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "Not a semantic release commit, skipping deployment"
            echo "is-release=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

  push-docker-image:
    name: Push Docker Image
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: check-release-commit
    if: needs.check-release-commit.outputs.is-release == 'true'
    environment: production

    steps:
      # 1) Check out your repo
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # 2) Log in to GitHub container registry
      - name: Log in to the Container registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      # 3) Extract docker metadata for tagging
      - name: Extract metadata (tags, labels) for Docker
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ghcr.io/purplefish-ai/agent

      # 4) Build and push Docker image
      - name: Build and push Docker image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: ./Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
  deploy-to-render:
    name: Deploy to Render
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [check-release-commit, push-docker-image]
    if: needs.check-release-commit.outputs.is-release == 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        # the rest is deploy via github actions in monorepo and ai-agents
        service:
          [
            "agent-inbound",
            "agent",
            "voice-agent",
            "routing-agent",
            "datadog-agent",
          ]
        include:
          - service: agent-inbound

          - service: agent

          - service: voice-agent

    steps:
      - name: Install Render CLI
        run: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/render-oss/cli/refs/heads/main/bin/install.sh | sh

      - name: Trigger Render deployment
        env:
          # The CLI can authenticate via a Render API key without logging in.
          RENDER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.RENDER_API_KEY }}
          RENDER_PROJECT_ID: ${{ secrets[matrix.service_id_env_key] }}

from abc import ABC
from abc import abstractmethod
from typing import Optional

from livekit.agents import JobContext
from livekit.protocol import sip as proto_sip


class ILiveKitService(ABC):
    """Interface for LiveKit service operations."""

    @abstractmethod
    async def hangup(self, ctx: JobContext) -> None:
        """Hang up the call and clean up the room."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def delete_room(self, ctx: JobContext) -> None:
        """Delete a LiveKit room."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def create_sip_participant(
        self,
        *,
        outbound_trunk_id: str,
        room_name: str,
        number: str,
        participant_name: str,
    ) -> proto_sip.SIPParticipantInfo:
        """Create a SIP participant in a LiveKit room."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def create_sip_participant_and_wait_for_pickup(
        self,
        *,
        ctx: JobContext,
        outbound_trunk_id: str,
        number: str,
        participant_name: str,
    ) -> proto_sip.SIPParticipantInfo | None:
        """Create a SIP participant and wait for the call to be picked up."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def start_room_composite_egress(self, room_name: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """Start room composite egress recording."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def stop_egress(self, egress_id: str) -> None:
        """Stop an active egress recording."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def remove_participant(
        self, room_name: str, participant_identity: str
    ) -> None:
        """Remove a participant from a LiveKit room."""
        pass

from livekit.agents import JobContext
from livekit.protocol import sip as proto_sip

from agent.services.interfaces.livekit_service import ILiveKitService

from . import livekit_api


class LiveKitService(ILiveKitService):
    """Implementation of the LiveKit service interface."""

    async def hangup(self, ctx: JobContext) -> None:
        """Hang up the call and clean up the room."""
        await livekit_api.hangup(ctx)

    async def delete_room(self, ctx: JobContext) -> None:
        """Delete a LiveKit room."""
        await livekit_api.delete_room(ctx)

    async def create_sip_participant(
        self,
        *,
        outbound_trunk_id: str,
        room_name: str,
        number: str,
        participant_name: str,
    ) -> proto_sip.SIPParticipantInfo:
        """Create a SIP participant in a LiveKit room."""
        return await livekit_api.create_sip_participant(
            outbound_trunk_id=outbound_trunk_id,
            room_name=room_name,
            number=number,
            participant_name=participant_name,
        )

    async def create_sip_participant_and_wait_for_pickup(
        self,
        *,
        ctx: JobContext,
        outbound_trunk_id: str,
        number: str,
        participant_name: str,
    ) -> proto_sip.SIPParticipantInfo | None:
        """Create a SIP participant and wait for the call to be picked up."""
        return await livekit_api.create_sip_participant_and_wait_for_pickup(
            ctx=ctx,
            outbound_trunk_id=outbound_trunk_id,
            number=number,
            participant_name=participant_name,
        )

    async def start_room_composite_egress(self, room_name: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """Start room composite egress recording."""
        return await livekit_api.start_room_composite_egress(room_name)

    async def stop_egress(self, egress_id: str) -> None:
        """Stop an active egress recording."""
        await livekit_api.stop_egress(egress_id)

    async def remove_participant(
        self, room_name: str, participant_identity: str
    ) -> None:
        """Remove a participant from a LiveKit room."""
        await livekit_api.remove_participant(room_name, participant_identity)

import asyncio
from typing import Any
from typing import Optional

from google.protobuf import duration_pb2
from livekit import api
from livekit import rtc
from livekit.agents import JobContext
from livekit.api.livekit_api import LiveKitAPI
from livekit.protocol import egress as proto_egress
from livekit.protocol import sip as proto_sip

from agent.env import env
from agent.log import logger


_client: Optional[LiveKitAPI] = None


async def hangup(ctx: JobContext) -> None:
    for remote_participant in ctx.room.remote_participants:
        try:
            logger.info(
                "Removing participant",
                extra={
                    "job_id": ctx.job.id,
                    "room_name": ctx.job.room.name,
                    "participant_identity": remote_participant,
                },
            )
            await remove_participant(ctx.job.room.name, remote_participant)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(
                "Failed to remove participant",
                extra={"job_id": ctx.job.id, "room_name": ctx.job.room.name},
                exc_info=e,
            )
    try:
        await delete_room(ctx)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(
            "Failed to delete room",
            extra={"job_id": ctx.job.id, "room_name": ctx.job.room.name},
            exc_info=e,
        )


def get_client() -> LiveKitAPI:
    global _client
    if _client is None:
        if env.AGENT_TYPE == "outbound":
            _client = LiveKitAPI(
                url=env.LIVEKIT_URL_OUTBOUND,
                api_key=env.LIVEKIT_API_KEY_OUTBOUND,
                api_secret=env.LIVEKIT_API_SECRET_OUTBOUND,
            )
        else:
            _client = LiveKitAPI(
                url=env.LIVEKIT_URL_INBOUND,
                api_key=env.LIVEKIT_API_KEY_INBOUND,
                api_secret=env.LIVEKIT_API_SECRET_INBOUND,
            )
    return _client


async def delete_room(ctx: JobContext) -> None:
    client = get_client()
    logger.info(
        "Deleting room",
        extra={"job_id": ctx.job.id, "room_name": ctx.job.room.name},
    )
    await client.room.delete_room(api.DeleteRoomRequest(room=ctx.job.room.name))


async def create_sip_participant(
    *, outbound_trunk_id: str, room_name: str, number: str, participant_name: str
) -> proto_sip.SIPParticipantInfo:
    client = get_client()
    sip_participant_request = proto_sip.CreateSIPParticipantRequest(
        room_name=room_name,
        sip_trunk_id=outbound_trunk_id,
        sip_call_to=number,
        participant_identity="sip-outbound-" + room_name + "-" + number,
        participant_name=participant_name,
        krisp_enabled=True,
    )
    result: proto_sip.SIPParticipantInfo = await client.sip.create_sip_participant(
        sip_participant_request
    )
    return result


async def create_sip_participant_and_wait_for_pickup(
    *,
    ctx: JobContext,
    outbound_trunk_id: str,
    number: str,
    participant_name: str,
) -> proto_sip.SIPParticipantInfo | None:
    print("create_sip_participant_and_wait_for_pickup")
    client = get_client()
    sip_participant_request = proto_sip.CreateSIPParticipantRequest(
        room_name=ctx.job.room.name,
        sip_trunk_id=outbound_trunk_id,
        sip_call_to=number,
        participant_identity="sip-outbound-" + ctx.job.room.name + "-" + number,
        participant_name=participant_name,
        ringing_timeout=duration_pb2.Duration(seconds=20),
        max_call_duration=duration_pb2.Duration(seconds=60 * 40),
    )

    finalized = asyncio.Event()
    connected: bool = False

    sip_participant: proto_sip.SIPParticipantInfo | None = None

    def participant_disconnected(participant: rtc.Participant) -> None:
        nonlocal connected
        if not sip_participant:
            return
        if sip_participant.participant_identity != participant.identity:
            return
        connected = False
        finalized.set()

    def participant_attributes_changed(_: Any, participant: rtc.Participant) -> None:
        nonlocal connected
        if not sip_participant:
            return
        if sip_participant.participant_identity != participant.identity:
            return
        if participant.attributes.get("sip.callStatus") == "active":
            connected = True
            finalized.set()

    ctx.room.on("participant_disconnected", participant_disconnected)
    ctx.room.on("participant_attributes_changed", participant_attributes_changed)

    sip_participant = await client.sip.create_sip_participant(sip_participant_request)
    await finalized.wait()
    ctx.room.off("participant_disconnected", participant_disconnected)
    ctx.room.off("participant_attributes_changed", participant_attributes_changed)
    if not connected:
        logger.info(
            "Call was hung up before pickup",
            extra={"job_id": ctx.job.id, "room_name": ctx.job.room.name},
        )
        return None
    logger.info(
        "Call was picked up",
        extra={"job_id": ctx.job.id, "room_name": ctx.job.room.name},
    )
    return sip_participant


async def start_room_composite_egress(room_name: str) -> Optional[str]:
    client = get_client()
    room_composite_request = api.RoomCompositeEgressRequest(
        room_name=room_name,
        layout="speaker-dark",
        audio_only=True,
        file_outputs=[
            api.EncodedFileOutput(
                filepath=f"livekit-demo/{room_name}/room-composite.mp4",
                file_type=api.EncodedFileType.MP4,
                s3=api.S3Upload(
                    access_key=env.R2_KEY,
                    secret=env.R2_SECRET,
                    bucket="livekit-egress",
                    endpoint=env.R2_ENDPOINT,
                    region="auto",
                ),
            )
        ],
    )

    try:
        egress_info = await client.egress.start_room_composite_egress(
            room_composite_request
        )
        logger.info(f"Started room composite egress: {egress_info}")
        return str(egress_info.egress_id)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to start room composite egress: {e}")
        return None


async def stop_egress(egress_id: str) -> None:
    try:
        client = get_client()
        stop_request = proto_egress.StopEgressRequest(egress_id=egress_id)
        logger.info(f"Stopping egress: {egress_id}")
        await client.egress.stop_egress(stop_request)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to stop egress: {egress_id} {e}")


async def remove_participant(room_name: str, participant_identity: str) -> None:
    client = get_client()
    await client.room.remove_participant(
        api.RoomParticipantIdentity(room=room_name, identity=participant_identity)
    )

    ) -> proto_sip.SIPParticipantInfo:
        """

            room_name: Name of the LiveKit room to add the participant to
            number: Phone number to call

            Exception: If the SIP participant creation fails

            span.set_attribute("room.name", room_name)
            span.set_attribute("sip.trunk_id", outbound_trunk_id)
            span.set_attribute("sip.number", number)
            span.set_attribute("participant.name", participant_name)
            
            try:
                # Create SIP participant request
                sip_participant_request = proto_sip.CreateSIPParticipantRequest(
                    room_name=room_name,
                    sip_trunk_id=outbound_trunk_id,
                    sip_call_to=number,
                    participant_identity=f"sip-outbound-{room_name}-{number}",

                    krisp_enabled=True,

                    sip_participant_request

                span.set_attribute("participant.identity", result.participant_identity)

                        "number": number,
                        "participant_identity": result.participant_identity,
                        "participant_id": result.participant_id,
                    },

                return result
                
            except Exception as e:
                span.set_attribute("error", True)
                span.set_attribute("error.type", type(e).__name__)
                
                logger.error(
                    "Failed to make outbound call",
                    extra={
                        "room_name": room_name,
                        "number": number,
                        "outbound_trunk_id": outbound_trunk_id,
                        "error_type": type(e).__name__,
                    },
                    exc_info=True,
                )
                raise

                self._client = None
                logger.debug("LiveKit API client closed")
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(
                    "Error closing LiveKit client",
                    extra={"error_type": type(e).__name__},
                    exc_info=True,

"""
LiveKit API client wrapper for routing agent operations
"""

from typing import Any
from typing import Dict
from typing import List
from typing import Optional

from livekit import api
from livekit.api import LiveKitAPI
from livekit.protocol import sip as proto_sip

from commons.monitoring import logging
from commons.monitoring.tracer import AgentTracer


logger = logging.get_logger(__name__)


class LiveKitClient:
    """Wrapper for LiveKit API operations with enhanced logging and tracing"""

    def __init__(
        self, url: str, api_key: str, api_secret: str, agent_tracer: AgentTracer
    ):
        """Initialize LiveKit API client"""
        self.tracer = agent_tracer.get_tracer(__name__)
        self.url = url
        self.api_key = api_key
        self.api_secret = api_secret
        self._client: Optional[LiveKitAPI] = None

        logger.debug("LiveKitClient initialized", extra={"url": url})

    @property
    def client(self) -> LiveKitAPI:
        """Get or create LiveKit API client lazily"""
        if self._client is None:
            self._client = LiveKitAPI(
                url=self.url, api_key=self.api_key, api_secret=self.api_secret
            )
            logger.debug("LiveKit API client created")
        return self._client

    async def list_participants(self, room_name: str) -> List[Any]:
        """List all participants in a room with tracing"""
        with self.tracer.start_as_current_span("livekit.list_participants") as span:
            span.set_attribute("room.name", room_name)

            try:
                response = await self.client.room.list_participants(
                    api.ListParticipantsRequest(room=room_name)
                )
                participants = list(response.participants)

                span.set_attribute("participant.count", len(participants))
                logger.debug(
                    "Listed participants",
                    extra={
                        "room_name": room_name,
                        "participant_count": len(participants),
                    },
                )
                return participants

            except Exception as e:
                span.set_attribute("error", True)
                span.set_attribute("error.type", type(e).__name__)
                logger.error(
                    "Failed to list participants",
                    extra={"room_name": room_name, "error_type": type(e).__name__},
                    exc_info=True,
                )
                raise

    async def get_participant_details(self, room_name: str, identity: str) -> Any:
        """Get detailed information about a specific participant with tracing"""
        with self.tracer.start_as_current_span("livekit.get_participant") as span:
            span.set_attribute("room.name", room_name)
            span.set_attribute("participant.identity", identity)

            try:
                response = await self.client.room.get_participant(
                    api.RoomParticipantIdentity(room=room_name, identity=identity)
                )

                logger.debug(
                    "Retrieved participant details",
                    extra={"room_name": room_name, "participant_identity": identity},
                )
                return response

            except Exception as e:
                span.set_attribute("error", True)
                span.set_attribute("error.type", type(e).__name__)
                logger.error(
                    "Failed to get participant details",
                    extra={
                        "room_name": room_name,
                        "participant_identity": identity,
                        "error_type": type(e).__name__,
                    },
                    exc_info=True,
                )
                raise

    async def update_room_metadata(self, room_name: str, metadata: str) -> None:
        """Update room metadata with tracing"""
        with self.tracer.start_as_current_span("livekit.update_metadata") as span:
            span.set_attribute("room.name", room_name)
            span.set_attribute("metadata.size", len(metadata))

            try:
                await self.client.room.update_room_metadata(
                    api.UpdateRoomMetadataRequest(room=room_name, metadata=metadata)
                )

                logger.info(
                    "Room metadata updated",
                    extra={"room_name": room_name, "metadata_size": len(metadata)},
                )

            except Exception as e:
                span.set_attribute("error", True)
                span.set_attribute("error.type", type(e).__name__)
                logger.error(
                    "Failed to update room metadata",
                    extra={
                        "room_name": room_name,
                        "metadata_size": len(metadata),
                        "error_type": type(e).__name__,
                    },
                    exc_info=True,
                )
                raise

    async def dispatch_agent(
        self, agent_name: str, room_name: str, metadata: Optional[str] = None
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Dispatch an agent to a room with comprehensive tracing"""
        with self.tracer.start_as_current_span("livekit.dispatch_agent") as span:
            span.set_attribute("agent.name", agent_name)
            span.set_attribute("room.name", room_name)
            span.set_attribute("has_metadata", metadata is not None)

            try:
                # Create dispatch request
                dispatch_request = api.CreateAgentDispatchRequest(
                    agent_name=agent_name, room=room_name
                )

                # Add metadata if provided
                if metadata:
                    dispatch_request.metadata = metadata
                    span.set_attribute("metadata.size", len(metadata))

                # Send dispatch request
                response = await self.client.agent_dispatch.create_dispatch(
                    dispatch_request
                )

                # Build dispatch result
                dispatch_result = {
                    "dispatch_id": response.id if hasattr(response, "id") else None,
                    "agent_name": agent_name,
                    "room": room_name,
                }

                span.set_attribute(
                    "dispatch.id", dispatch_result.get("dispatch_id", "")
                )
                span.set_attribute("dispatch.success", True)

                logger.info(
                    "Agent dispatched successfully",
                    extra={
                        "agent_name": agent_name,
                        "room_name": room_name,
                        "dispatch_id": dispatch_result.get("dispatch_id"),
                    },
                )

                return dispatch_result

            except Exception as e:
                span.set_attribute("error", True)
                span.set_attribute("error.type", type(e).__name__)
                span.set_attribute("dispatch.success", False)

                logger.error(
                    "Failed to dispatch agent",
                    extra={
                        "agent_name": agent_name,
                        "room_name": room_name,
                        "error_type": type(e).__name__,
                    },
                    exc_info=True,
                )
                raise

    async def delete_dispatch(self, dispatch_id: str, room_name: str) -> None:
        """Delete an agent dispatch with tracing"""
        with self.tracer.start_as_current_span("livekit.delete_dispatch") as span:
            span.set_attribute("dispatch.id", dispatch_id)
            span.set_attribute("room.name", room_name)

            try:
                await self.client.agent_dispatch.delete_dispatch(dispatch_id, room_name)

                logger.info(
                    "Dispatch deleted",
                    extra={"dispatch_id": dispatch_id, "room_name": room_name},
                )

            except Exception as e:
                span.set_attribute("error", True)
                span.set_attribute("error.type", type(e).__name__)

                logger.error(
                    "Failed to delete dispatch",
                    extra={
                        "dispatch_id": dispatch_id,
                        "room_name": room_name,
                        "error_type": type(e).__name__,
                    },
                    exc_info=True,
                )
                raise

    async def close(self) -> None:
        """Close the API client connection"""
        if self._client:
            try:
                await self._client.aclose()
                self._client = None
                logger.debug("LiveKit API client closed")
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(
                    "Error closing LiveKit client",
                    extra={"error_type": type(e).__name__},
                    exc_info=True,
                )

"""Unit tests for RoutingAgent"""

import json
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock
from unittest.mock import Mock

import pytest
from livekit.agents import JobContext

from commons.enums import AgentType
from commons.monitoring import AgentMonitoring
from commons.schemas.config import EnvironmentConfig
from commons.schemas.ingest import InboundRoomMetadata
from commons.schemas.ingest import OutboundRoomMetadata
from commons.schemas.ingest import PlaygroundRoomMetadata
from commons.schemas.ingest import WebRoomMetadata
from commons.schemas.purplefish import CreateEngagementResponse
from commons.services.purplefish_client import PurplefishClient
from routing_agent.router import RoutingAgent


class TestRoutingAgent:
    """Test suite for RoutingAgent class"""

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_initialization(
        self,
        mock_job_context: JobContext,
        mock_environment_config: EnvironmentConfig,
        mock_agent_monitor: AgentMonitoring,
        purplefish_client,
    ):
        """Test RoutingAgent initialization"""
        # Create routing agent
        agent = RoutingAgent(
            mock_job_context,
            mock_environment_config,
            mock_agent_monitor,
            purplefish_client,
        )

        # Verify initialization
        assert agent.ctx == mock_job_context
        assert agent.environment_config == mock_environment_config
        assert agent.room_name == "test_room_123"
        assert agent.livekit_client is not None
        assert agent.purplefish_client is not None

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_initialization_with_purplefish_client(
        self,
        mock_job_context: JobContext,
        mock_environment_config: EnvironmentConfig,
        mock_agent_monitor: AgentMonitoring,
        purplefish_client: PurplefishClient,
    ):
        """Test RoutingAgent initialization with provided PurplefishClient"""
        # Create routing agent with purplefish client
        agent = RoutingAgent(
            mock_job_context,
            mock_environment_config,
            mock_agent_monitor,
            purplefish_client,
        )

        # Verify the provided client is used
        assert agent.purplefish_client == purplefish_client

    @pytest.mark.asyncio

        self,
        mock_job_context: JobContext,
        mock_environment_config: EnvironmentConfig,
        mock_agent_monitor: AgentMonitoring,
        mock_livekit_client: AsyncMock,
        sample_sip_participant,
        sample_sip_attributes,
        purplefish_client,
    ):
        """Test SIP participant detection"""
        # Setup mock participant with SIP attributes
        participant_details = Mock()
        participant_details.attributes = sample_sip_attributes

        mock_livekit_client.list_participants.return_value = [sample_sip_participant]
        mock_livekit_client.get_participant_details.return_value = participant_details

        # Create agent with mocked livekit client
        agent = RoutingAgent(
            mock_job_context,
            mock_environment_config,
            mock_agent_monitor,
            purplefish_client,
        )
        agent.livekit_client = mock_livekit_client

        # Get participant data
        participant_data = await agent._get_participant_data()

        # Verify SIP data extraction
        assert participant_data is not None
        assert participant_data["candidate_phone_number"] == "+1234567890"
        assert participant_data["agent_trunk_id"] == "trunk_001"
        assert participant_data["agent_phone_number"] == "+0987654321"
        assert participant_data["kind"] == "inbound"
        assert participant_data["type"] == "sip"

"""Unit tests for RoutingAgent"""

import json
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock
from unittest.mock import Mock

import pytest
from livekit.agents import JobContext

from commons.enums import AgentType
from commons.monitoring import AgentMonitoring
from commons.schemas.config import EnvironmentConfig
from commons.schemas.ingest import CallKind

from commons.schemas.ingest import PlaygroundRoomMetadata
from commons.schemas.ingest import WebRoomMetadata
from commons.schemas.purplefish import CreateEngagementResponse
from commons.services.purplefish_client import PurplefishClient
from routing_agent.router import RoutingAgent


class TestRoutingAgent:
    """Test suite for RoutingAgent class"""

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_initialization(
        self,
        mock_job_context: JobContext,
        mock_environment_config: EnvironmentConfig,
        mock_agent_monitor: AgentMonitoring,
        purplefish_client,
    ):
        """Test RoutingAgent initialization"""
        # Create routing agent
        agent = RoutingAgent(
            mock_job_context,
            mock_environment_config,
            mock_agent_monitor,
            purplefish_client,
        )

        # Verify initialization
        assert agent.ctx == mock_job_context
        assert agent.environment_config == mock_environment_config
        assert agent.room_name == "test_room_123"
        assert agent.livekit_client is not None
        assert agent.purplefish_client is not None

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_initialization_with_purplefish_client(
        self,
        mock_job_context: JobContext,
        mock_environment_config: EnvironmentConfig,
        mock_agent_monitor: AgentMonitoring,
        purplefish_client: PurplefishClient,
    ):
        """Test RoutingAgent initialization with provided PurplefishClient"""
        # Create routing agent with purplefish client
        agent = RoutingAgent(
            mock_job_context,
            mock_environment_config,
            mock_agent_monitor,
            purplefish_client,
        )

        # Verify the provided client is used
        assert agent.purplefish_client == purplefish_client

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_detect_sip_participant(
        self,
        mock_job_context: JobContext,
        mock_environment_config: EnvironmentConfig,
        mock_agent_monitor: AgentMonitoring,
        mock_livekit_client: AsyncMock,
        sample_sip_participant,
        sample_sip_attributes,
        purplefish_client,
    ):
        """Test SIP participant detection"""
        # Setup mock participant with SIP attributes
        participant_details = Mock()
        participant_details.attributes = sample_sip_attributes

        mock_livekit_client.list_participants.return_value = [sample_sip_participant]
        mock_livekit_client.get_participant_details.return_value = participant_details

        # Create agent with mocked livekit client
        agent = RoutingAgent(
            mock_job_context,
            mock_environment_config,
            mock_agent_monitor,
            purplefish_client,
        )
